letybo.text: Users get Letybo to soften the frown lines between the eyebrows, giving a smoother, more relaxed look within days of the injection. It is one of several botulinum toxin brands in hardmaxx circles, and glabellar lines are the use it was approved and trialled for.

relfydess.text: Relfydess is a ready-to-use liquid toxin that people choose to smooth frown lines, with the visible softening appearing after the injection takes effect. Its frown-line use is backed by a Phase 3 trial; interest in the liquid format comes from not needing reconstitution.

nabota.text: Nabota, sold as Jeuveau in the US, is used to smooth frown lines and is also discussed for slimming the masseter muscle in the lower face. Wrinkle use has trial support; the jaw-slimming use is studied in smaller reports and is largely off-label.

botulax-hutox-meditoxin.text: These Korean toxin brands are used abroad to smooth wrinkles and to slim the jaw by reducing masseter bulk, which is the draw for people seeking a narrower lower face. Trials mostly compare them with Botox for wrinkles; the masseter use has been studied in smaller datasets.

trap-botox-barbie-botox.text: Trap Botox is promoted to relax the trapezius so the neck looks longer and the shoulder line more slender. It is an off-label cosmetic use; a 2024 systematic review exists, but cosmetic outcome data for this specific look are thin and mostly anecdotal.

juvederm-voluma.text: Voluma is a firm hyaluronic acid filler used to add cheek and chin volume, giving visible lift and projection without surgery. Users describe it as a temporary stand-in for implants; the volume effect is covered by manufacturer-backed studies.

chain: Chin and jaw angle built out
juvederm-volux.text: Volux is a firm hyaluronic acid gel placed in the chin and jawline to build out a stronger lower-third contour, visible once swelling settles. Published trials cover chin and jaw augmentation; comparisons with Voluma come largely from forum anecdote.

chain: Fine HA gel adds soft volume
juvederm-volbella.text: Volbella is a low-concentration hyaluronic acid filler used for subtle lip definition and to soften the under-eye hollow, with the change visible straight away. Randomized trials support these uses; later reactions in the tear-trough area are reported in the literature.

chain: HA gels add volume by area
restylane-defyne-lyft-kysse.text: This Restylane family covers cheeks and midface (Lyft), smile lines and contour (Defyne) and lips (Kysse), so users pick a product by the feature they want to change. The results are visible on injection; randomized trials exist mainly for Lyft.

chain: Flexible HA gel moves with face
rha-fillers-teoxane.text: RHA fillers are designed to stay natural in areas that move, so people use them around the mouth and lips and in under-eye hollows. The filled look is visible immediately; randomized perioral and under-eye trials support these uses.

chain: Soft cohesive HA integrates in skin
belotero-balance.text: Belotero Balance is a soft hyaluronic acid filler used for fine lines and for under-eye hollows, giving a smoother, brighter-looking area soon after injection. A 12-month randomized comparison exists; forum posters also discuss filler as a precursor or stand-in for surgery, which is anecdotal.

ellans-pcl-filler.text: Ellanse is a collagen-stimulating filler promoted for longer-lasting facial volume, because the body lays down new collagen around its microspheres over time. Support comes from small prospective studies.

aquamid-polyacrylamide-filler.text: Aquamid is a permanent polyacrylamide filler chosen by people who want lasting facial volume rather than repeat sessions. The volume is visible on injection and stays, with a five-year study behind it and late reactions documented in the literature.

autologous-fat-transfer-to-face.text: Fat transfer uses a person's own fat to restore facial volume or reshape contour, favoured by those who prefer their own tissue over manufactured fillers. Fat grafting is an established surgical technique; how much of the fat remains over time varies.

chain: HA or CaHA added along mandible
jawline-filler.text: Users get jawline filler to add definition to the jaw angle and chin and to soften the look of jowls, with a sharper line visible once swelling settles. It is a non-surgical route used by people weighing it against jaw surgery; trials are registered and the claimed value against surgery is opinion.

temple-filler.text: Temple filler is used to fill the hollow at the side of the forehead, giving the upper face a smoother outline and better balance. The fill is visible on injection; most published research on the area is anatomical rather than outcome-focused.

tear-trough-filler.text: Tear trough filler is used to soften the shadowed hollow under the eyes, giving a more rested look quickly and with little downtime. Some people treat it as an alternative to lower eyelid surgery; the noticeable-yet-natural claim comes mainly from practitioner and forum reports.

chain: Filler placed through one entry point
cannula-filler-technique.text: Cannula technique places filler through a blunt flexible tube instead of a needle, so users and injectors choose it for even spread of product across a wider area. It is a delivery method rather than a product; evidence is limited to small product-specific trials.

chain: Smoother texture, less scarring and pigment
fraxel-fraxel-restore-dual.text: Fraxel is used over multiple sessions to improve scars, sun damage and melasma, with the skin renewing over days to weeks. Small studies support these uses; Fraxel Dual adds a wavelength aimed at superficial pigment.

clear-brilliant.text: Clear + Brilliant is a mild fractional laser people use as a starter or maintenance treatment for tone and texture, with minimal downtime. It is nicknamed a baby Fraxel and its support comes from small trials.

chain: Even tone, smoother scars and texture
halo-laser-hybrid-fractional.text: Halo combines ablative and non-ablative wavelengths in one pass and is used for sun damage, scars and pigment. Cited evidence is limited to small registered studies.

chain: Smoother scars and fewer deep wrinkles
fractional-co2-laser-co2re-ultrapulse-sm.text: Fractional CO2 is the stronger laser option used for scars and deep wrinkles, with the skin renewing over a longer recovery. It is the best-studied of the fractional lasers; CO2RE, UltraPulse and SmartXide are common systems.

chain: Skin heals with less heat damage
Smoother texture, fewer scars and wrinkles
erbium-yag-resurfacing.text: Er:YAG resurfacing is used on acne scars, deep wrinkles and melasma, and is described as a shallower option with less heat than CO2. The skin-specific evidence in the sources is thin.

chain: Skin remodels with fewer side effects
pico-genesis-picosure-pro.text: Picosecond lasers such as PicoSure Pro are used for acne scars, pigmented spots and skin texture. Published datasets are small and the evidence is still developing.

ruby-laser.text: The ruby laser was historically used for hair removal, pigment and tattoos, and is now largely replaced by newer wavelengths. It is the first laser ever built, which is why it appears on the wiki.

alexandrite-laser-hair-removal.text: Alexandrite lasers are used in clinics to reduce facial and body hair, mainly on lighter skin with dark hair. Hair reduction is established across the hair-removal literature; the result is a reduction rather than total removal.

diode-laser-hair-removal-lightsheer.text: Diode lasers such as LightSheer are the common clinic option for reducing facial and body hair, suited to pale to medium skin. Registered clinical trials exist for the brand.

chain: Follicles heated with less surface absorption
nd-yag-laser-hair-removal.text: Nd:YAG is the hair-removal laser people with darker skin tones turn to for facial and body hair reduction. Its deeper wavelength is chosen to lessen absorption in surface melanin.

chain: Hair growth slows with lower pain
soprano-ice-laser.text: The Soprano Ice is marketed as a more comfortable hair-removal laser, combining 755, 810 and 1064 nm in one device. Evidence includes one small study of the Platinum model in darker skin.

gentlemax-pro.text: GentleMax Pro is a clinic laser used mainly for hair removal across skin tones, and in looksmaxxing circles it is discussed for facial hair reduction. Evidence comes from small studies plus general hair-removal data.
